metadata.architectural_response: Two inhabited inclined wings physically intersect around a shared central room. Their changing upper section and oblique crossing create different open edges, while each wing bears on the ground along its length.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: Programme, doors, stairs, accessible roof routes, structural member capacity and parking operation remain to be designed and independently verified.
